headline: Meghna Anup Gala steps down as Chairman of SEL Manufacturing

modes.bear: Sudden leadership exits at the top can create uncertainty in company management.
modes.bull: A new chairperson could bring fresh strategic direction to turn around operations.
modes.simple: The top boss of SEL Manufacturing is stepping down in September 2026. Investors should watch who takes over next.

summary: SEL Manufacturing Company Limited has announced the cessation of Ms Meghna Anup Gala as Chairman of the company, effective September 20, 2026. The exchange filing details the change in leadership without disclosing immediate succession plans. Retail investors should note this managerial shift as it alters the corporate governance structure of the listed entity.
why_it_matters: Management transition at the top requires monitoring for strategic direction.
